title: Copy to clipboard button
when: The user wants a button that copies a code block, a link, a coupon or any text with one click.
prompt:
Goal: A copy button that uses the async clipboard API, falls back cleanly and confirms the copy visually and to screen readers.
Steps:
1. <button type="button" data-copy-target="coupon"> next to the text; read the target textContent or value at click time.
2. Call await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text) inside try and catch; it needs a secure context (https or localhost).
3. Fallback: select the text with a Range or in a readonly input and tell the user to press Ctrl+C.
4. Confirm: the button label turns to Copied for 2 s and a role="status" region says Copied to clipboard; keep a min-width so the button does not jump.
5. For code blocks, add one button to each pre with JS and copy the code element text.
Quality bar:
- Copies exactly the visible text, no extra spaces.
- One button per copyable item.
- Works by keyboard as any button.
Pitfalls:
- Uncaught promise rejections when permission is denied.
- document.execCommand as the main path.
- A success message that also shows on failure.
Verify:
- [ ] Buttons have type="button" and clear names.
- [ ] Errors are caught and the fallback works.
- [ ] A live region announces the copy.
- [ ] The label resets after 2 s.
Output: Button markup next to each item and copy.js.

examples.input: botao para copiar o cupom de desconto
examples.output: button Copy code next to the coupon, clipboard.writeText in try, label Copied for 2 s, status message
